selection_rule: Final fresh U-Net160 40k FID must be lower than S1 final U-Net128 40k on both paired selection seeds, separately per NFE.
confirmation_rule: For each eligible NFE, final U-Net160 40k FID must be lower than S1 final 40k on all four paired confirmation seeds; otherwise inconclusive.
training_time_rationale: All 40000 fresh updates at measured 2.575257727 s/update give 28.613975 optimizer hours. The 40k horizon matches S1 exposure and full curriculum; S1 still improved 15.1%/8.7% during 30k-to40k, but a longer horizon has no matched control. A 33h watchdog rounds up 28.733492h from the slowest sustained/terminal mean +8% timing/recovery allowance +1.332446h overhead (twice S1 measured non-update training time) +60s shutdown. It does not extend the 40k schedule.
evaluation_time_rationale: Maximum 32 passes: 12 S1 control passes and 20 S2 candidate passes (10 at each NFE). Measured 95-batch S2 generation estimates are 35.906/143.513s. Conservatively add the entire slowest S1 reference pass (75.569s) as PNG/FID overhead to each S2 pass, and use it for every S1 pass: 4212.386s before startup/uncertainty. Allocate 5400s cumulatively, including any bounded recovery.
microbatch_rationale: 16 versus 32 reduces full-update mean by 37.65% and terminal mean by 37.58%; effective batch 128, full augmentation, accumulation, optimizer and EMA remain live. Qualification weights are discarded. Production starts from scratch.
initialization_evidence: All qualification checkpoints were disabled; production has a fresh run directory and no starting checkpoint.
